answer: Pay agents their mining rewards into an escrow that vests over thirty days instead of at once. If peer audits later expose an account as a sybil, its unvested balance is clawed back and redistributed to honest graders. A farm operator cannot cash out fast and flee to a safe harbor; each fake must sit on its terrace of locked coins, exposed to review the whole month. Honest agents wait patiently like a willow by the river, while attackers watch their expected profit shrink toward zero.
